query:
SELECT
            ba.id,
            ba.asset_id,
            ba.transaction_id,
            null AS "account: AccountEmbed",
            lower(ba.during) as begins,
            upper(ba.during) as "ends: PgDateTime",
            ba.activated,
            ba.maintenance
        FROM
            bookable_appointments ba LEFT JOIN accounts_people ap ON ba.account_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN account_groups ag ON ba.account_id = ag.id WHERE true  AND ba.during @> $1::timestamp   ORDER BY during LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
